title: Failure of the split search
statement: For natural numbers $C,c,m$, the exponential-split search fails exactly when there is no natural number $n$ satisfying $n+C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}=m$.
replaced:
The exponential-split search on $(C, c, m)$ fails if and only if no natural
number $n$ satisfies $n + C \cdot 2^{(n+1)^c} = m$.
